about: Basis variants as integers, which are the clock vocabulary's own definition: unspecified 0 to file_read 6, then display_frame 7, audio_output_buffer 8, clock_read 9 and platform_event_timestamp 10, the last four provisional. A basis crosses a boundary and is recorded as its integer, so no value is renumbered or reused. Row names are the variant names in snake case. A face that renumbers, or appends in another order, fails a row.
